car.name: Bugle 1966
car.description: Ken Miles / Lloyd Ruby, 1966 Daytona-winning Ford GT40 Mk II P/1015 inspiration. Mid-mounted 427 V8, rear drive and four-speed T44 manual. Original aubergine/copper endurance art. Event setup estimates are labeled, not later Le Mans upgrades.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Ken Miles / Lloyd Ruby, 1966 Daytona 24 Hours-winning Ford GT40 Mk II P/1015, car 98. Not Mk I, replica, road car or later Le Mans rebuild.

sources.access: Museum identifies P/1015 Mk II, Miles/Ruby win on 6 February, 485 horsepower 427 and Kar Kraft T44 four-speed. Later dry-sump engine and Le Mans modifications are explicitly subsequent, not assumed here.
Manufacturer corroborates 427 Mk II, short nose, four-speed manual and Miles/Ruby Daytona win.
Museum race photograph identifies #98 GT40 Mark II and Miles/Ruby Daytona victory, 6 February 1966.

estimates: 1100 kg, 475 lb-ft, RPM thresholds and complete torque curve, 195 mph and 4.4 s 0–60 targets are simulation estimates, not verified Daytona event figures. Museum 210 mph is itself an estimate and not adopted as event timing. 7.0 L is rounded 427 cubic-inch displacement.

Dimensions, mass distribution, gear ratios and final drive, differential, suspension, aero, brakes and 35 gallon tank are game estimates. Equal 245/60R15 tires approximate period racing rubber without historic front/rear stagger. No later dry-sump or Le Mans rebuild claim.

Original aubergine/copper/cream exterior, magnesium-style wheels and right-hand cockpit are interpretations, not copied #98 livery. Live digital instruments, shared wheel/wipers and generic sound are gameplay conventions. Auto Assist is accessibility, not a factory automatic. Native decoded-wheel opacity normalization preserves original PNGs.
